SELECT q.no,q.member_id,m.name,c.category,q.subject,q.status,TO_CHAR(q.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS dbday FROM qnaboard q JOIN qna_category c ON q.category_no=c.no JOIN member m ON q.member_id=m.member_id
AND (subject LIKE '%'||#{fd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%' OR content LIKE '%'||#{fd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%')
AND q.category_no=#{categoryNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}
ORDER BY no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT q.no,q.member_id,m.name,c.category,q.category_no AS categoryNo,q.subject,q.status,TO_CHAR(q.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS dbday,q.content FROM qnaboard q JOIN qna_category c ON q.category_no=c.no JOIN member m ON q.member_id=m.member_id WHERE q.no=#{no}
